name: OpenGLApp: a Python Creative-Coding Framework
description: A small framework over GLFW and PyOpenGL, modelled on Processing (the Java creative-coding sketchbook): subclass OpenGLApp, write setup() and update(), and windows, input, shaders and uniforms are handled for you. Used throughout Advanced Computer Graphics, up to the final project.
highlights: Vertex and fragment shaders live in one .glsl file, split on marker comments
Typed uniform setter backed by a table of glProgramUniform* calls, with readable errors when a value's type doesn't match
A misspelt uniform name gets a "Did you mean…?" suggestion, ranked by Levenshtein distance
